window._rb2p_CONV_SPOT_2PT: constant 48 (the 2-yard line) set once at 9496 and never reassigned; the conversion pin and gate compare the ball to it, but a fixed number cannot latch or be waited on
window._rb2p_CONV_SPOT_KICK: constant 35 (the 1-pt kick spot) set once at 9497; read only so the PAT invariant stands down at the legal kick spot, never reassigned or waited on
window._rb2p_DIFFICULTY_TIERS: constant tier list (easy..ultramax) used to validate the stored difficulty; never reassigned, never waited on
window._rb2p_FB: test seam: the Firebase database namespace exposed so harnesses can swap FB.set; the page never reads it back through this name
window._rb2p_TEAM_COLORS: static per-team colour table published for the arena theme; display only
window._rb2p_TEAM_ROSTERS: static curated roster table (lobby preview, starred defenders, defense-aggression rating); constant data, never a condition anything waits on
window._rb2p_aimShort: test-bot tuning knob (?bot= tabs only) that pulls the bot's throw target in; the game never reads it
window._rb2p_aimUp: test-bot tuning knob (?bot= tabs only): vertical aim offset for the bot's throw; the game never reads it
window._rb2p_baseOpDifficulty: native op_difficulty (_2t) cached once so the difficulty tier can be restored; changes defender behaviour only
window._rb2p_blastPrevScorerScore: score baseline for the WAIT-screen TD/FG popup; display only, reset to 0 at match start
window._rb2p_botPaused: test-director pause for the ?bot= autoplay tab; only stops the bot's own synthetic taps, never set by the game
window._rb2p_boxPubSeq: sequence number stamped on each box-score write-through (rooms/{code}/box); nothing reads it to decide anything
window._rb2p_clockLicenceUntil: clock-law licence window: while open an upward clock write is accepted instead of put back; it changes what the clock reads, never whether a snap, hand-off, conversion or final happens
window._rb2p_clockLicenceWhy: reason text of the last clock licence; written for diagnostics, never read
window._rb2p_cmtLog: rolling log of commentary lines and the licence that produced each (diagnostic readout); debug only
window._rb2p_convGateLastRefusal: text of the conversion gate's last refusal, exposed only through _rb2p_convGateStats; diagnostic
window._rb2p_convKickLogMs: 4s throttle on the 'kick spot 35 is legal' diag line; the PAT-invariant stand-down it logs happens regardless
window._rb2p_convOtherLogMs: 10s throttle on the 'CONVGATE pass (not a conversion)' diag line in the _wm wrapper; log only
window._rb2p_convWallPatienceFor: remembers which conversion offer the 'wall waits' diag line was already written for; gates only that log line
window._rb2p_conversionLastLicence: last conversion licence string, read only by the gate stats accessor and the 'CONVGATE allow' log; diagnostic
window._rb2p_db: test seam: the Firebase database handle exposed so harnesses can goOffline/goOnline; the page never reads it back
window._rb2p_deadOppLogMs: 60s throttle on the DEAD-OPP WAIT diag line (V419 removed the one-sided FINAL it used to trigger); log only
window._rb2p_defDiag: defensive-credit diagnostic counters (play ends, tackles, sacks, INTs, misses); telemetry only
window._rb2p_defObsLog: append-only log of observed tackles/sacks and who got credit; telemetry only
window._rb2p_deliveryIv: interval handle of the delivery watchdog, kept only so a re-install clears the old timer; the handle itself gates nothing
window._rb2p_diffMode: SAME/DIFF difficulty mode mirrored for the in-game badge label; display only
window._rb2p_doKeepDrive: test seam: a reference to the quarter-keep doKeepDrive function (code, not state)
window._rb2p_engineBk1ReadCount: counter of reads through the _Bk1 accessor, which is a pass-through since V57; telemetry for the self-test
window._rb2p_engineBk1SuppressCount: counter of suppressed _Bk1 reads; the suppressor is inert since V57 so it never moves; telemetry only
window._rb2p_evtBlastedAt: per-kind timestamps of WAIT-screen event popups, used only to de-duplicate those popups; display only
window._rb2p_fbConnected: last Firebase .info/connected value, kept so the FB-CONN transition is logged once; log only
window._rb2p_fbStallLogMs: 10s throttle on the FB-STALL live->REST warn line; the REST mirror itself is not gated by it
window._rb2p_fbStallN: count of outcome sends the SDK failed to confirm within 1.5s; telemetry, the REST re-send happens regardless
window._rb2p_feedCatchName: on-field catch name used only to name a pass receiver in the play-by-play line; never classifies the play or gates anything
window._rb2p_finalConvWaitLogMs: 10s throttle on the 'FINAL waits, a conversion is still being played' diag line; the wait itself is convLiveF
window._rb2p_forceRoomCode: test seam: the e2e harness pins the host's 4-letter room code; unset in normal play, only affects code generation
window._rb2p_hbSuspend: test seam (V403): stops this page's heartbeat to simulate a phone that left; never set by the page
window._rb2p_hbUrl: cached authenticated heartbeat URL reused by the pagehide 'left' beacon, which only changes the partner's cover text
window._rb2p_intCreditedThisPlay: once-per-play dedupe of the defensive INT stat credit; box-score stats only
window._rb2p_intReturnActive: turnover-return flag that drops the MAX defender speed bump during a return; changes defender speed only, no gate reads it
window._rb2p_keepLoopDiagMs: 5s throttle on the QTR-KEEP LOOP diag line; the keep refusal and heal run regardless
window._rb2p_kyRefusedLogMs: 5s throttle on the 'KY refused' diag/audit line; the post-horn kickoff refusal runs regardless
window._rb2p_lastBoxSig: signature of the last box-score write, used only to skip identical fire-and-forget writes; gameplay never waits on the box

window._rb2p_lastGoodBoxScore: cached full box score used as content fallback for the FINAL card; data for the stats screen, never a condition

window._rb2p_lastGoodYard: last good own-ball yard line, used only to undo an exact-negation yard teleport; rewrites the spot, never refuses or waits
window._rb2p_lastIntEvtMs: 5s dedupe for sending the INT/FUMBLE event popup; display only
window._rb2p_lastOtBoxScore: box-score snapshot kept during OT as the FINAL report's content if the engine ends natively; data, never a condition
window._rb2p_lastPickSixAutoTestReport: report object of the opt-in, observe-only pick-six auto-test; diagnostic only
window._rb2p_lastScoreSyncMs: wire-sync stamp that stops the score-jump watcher blasting a synced +6/+3/+2 as an event popup; display only
window._rb2p_lastSyncedEngineClock: record of the last clock applied from an outcome; written, never read
window._rb2p_lastThrow: test-bot record of its last throw (?bot= tabs), written for inspection; never read by the game
window._rb2p_lastTurnoverVy8Ms: real-time Vy=8 stamp that sets the outcome's cosmetic turnover hint and suppresses takeaway popups; the type and the hand-off are untouched
window._rb2p_leadT: test-bot tuning knob (?bot= tabs): receiver lead time for the bot's aim; not read by the game
window._rb2p_maxDrag: test-bot tuning knob (?bot= tabs): cap on the bot's throw drag; not read by the game
window._rb2p_myTeamUid: this player's team id used to build identity, jerseys, rosters and names at match start and for display; never a condition that waits
window._rb2p_myVer: this build's version number for the version-jump chip, diag label and mismatch banner; display only
window._rb2p_ofCur: test-bot receiver positions this tick (?bot= tabs) used for the bot's aim; not read by the game
window._rb2p_ofPrev: test-bot receiver positions from the previous tick (?bot= tabs) for its velocity estimate; not read by the game
window._rb2p_ofPrevSaved: test-bot copy of the last receiver sample, written for inspection only; never read
window._rb2p_oppTeamUid: opponent team id used for jerseys, starred defenders, names and the defense-aggression rating; never a condition that waits
window._rb2p_oppVer: opponent's build number; only switches the legacy score-delta popup off for V335+ opponents (display)
window._rb2p_otIllegalLogged: once-per-period flag for the 'period 5 with a decided score, OT not armed' log line; log only
window._rb2p_otMaskLogMs: 30s throttle on the OT-LABEL masked diag line; the FINAL label masking runs regardless
window._rb2p_otPossSig: de-dup signature (period:my:opp) for the OT-counter sessionStorage write-through; it only skips re-writing an unchanged value, and a page plays one match (the FINAL's only exit reloads) so it is never stale
window._rb2p_outcomePollIv: interval handle of the 3s REST receive poll, kept only so a re-install clears the old timer; the handle gates nothing
window._rb2p_p6Local: local mirror of pick-six ledger step times; written, never read by the page
window._rb2p_p6ScorerSentMs: stamp of the scorer's PAT_RESULT send (V366); written at every send, never read by the page
window._rb2p_patDedupKills: count of duplicate PAT modal popups destroyed; telemetry only
window._rb2p_patInvSnappedLogMs: 5s throttle on the 'PAT-INV standing down, the try was snapped' diag line; the stand-down runs regardless
window._rb2p_patPinHoldUntil: pin-hold deadline stamped at the PICK6 apply (V338); nothing in the page reads it
window._rb2p_patPinResyncMs: 1.5s rate limit on redrawing the scrimmage while a conversion is pinned; the register pin itself is unconditional (display)
window._rb2p_patResultPoints: points of the resolved pick-six try; written at every resolution, never read by the page
window._rb2p_pick6MonitorLastReport: last pick-six monitor report for the console accessor; diagnostic only
window._rb2p_possLastChangeMs: stamp of the last WAIT/LIVE transition through the possession accessor; written, never read
window._rb2p_preRolloverDown: captured down for a quarter keep; decides which down the kept drive resumes on, never whether it is staged
window._rb2p_preRolloverToGo: captured distance for a quarter keep; decides the resumed distance only, never whether it is staged
window._rb2p_preRolloverYard: captured live spot for a quarter keep and the ball-gate anchor; decides where the drive resumes, never whether
window._rb2p_previewUid: team id of the lobby roster preview, used to recolour roster cards; lobby display only
window._rb2p_qBackLogMs: 4s throttle on the QTR-BACK warn line; the quarter restore runs regardless
window._rb2p_qEndLatchDown: settled end-of-quarter down; decides the kept drive's down only
window._rb2p_qEndLatchToGo: settled end-of-quarter distance; decides the kept drive's distance only
window._rb2p_qGovPrevQ: quarter-governor bookkeeping (last quarter seen) for the one-fresh-clock top-up; a withheld top-up leaves the clock at 0:00, which satisfies the keep's other entry condition (clock value only)
window._rb2p_qToppedEver: quarter-governor record of which quarters already got their one fresh clock; it only decides a clock top-up (withheld = clock stays 0:00, still a keep entry)
window._rb2p_qbSacksTaken: count of sacks taken, subtracted from QB carries on the FINAL card; stats only
window._rb2p_qsyncLog: console verbosity toggle for the scrimmage re-sync log; log only
window._rb2p_quarterLenSec: observed maximum quarter length; only a fallback clock value when the agreed setting is missing, and the agreed setting is always 1/2/3
window._rb2p_recvStatInited: once-per-match crash-guard flag for zero-initialising stat_receive on roster structs; gates only that one-time write and resets whenever the page leaves the match room
window._rb2p_rescueHeldLogMs: 5s throttle on the 'TURN-RESCUE applying the held hand-off' log; the drain runs regardless
window._rb2p_rescueHiddenLogged: once-per-hidden-spell flag for the 'TURN-RESCUE stood down, opponent screen off' log; log only
window._rb2p_resumeRawOffStats: saved offensive box stats re-asserted during the ~3s resume hold (only raises stat values); stats only
window._rb2p_rosterPreviewActive: lobby roster-preview flag; its loop only strips buttons in the roster/profile rooms (never rm_match) and startMatch resets it
window._rb2p_scoreBaseline: test-observable mirror of the drive-end watchdog's score baseline; written, never read
window._rb2p_spawnReloadAfterFails: test knob for the poisoned-spawn counter, whose only remaining action is a diag line (auto-reload removed in V279)
window._rb2p_stableDir: driver-latched drive direction copied into the engine by the conversion pin, PAT invariant and Q3 law and compared by the DIR-GUARD; it corrects which way the field faces, never refuses or waits
window._rb2p_stallWorker: handle of the off-thread stall-telemetry worker; telemetry only
window._rb2p_stallWorkerFeed: test seam: the function that re-feeds the stall worker its audit URL (code, telemetry)
window._rb2p_testRenderFaults: test seam: a harness sets it to make renderFinal throw N times; the page never sets it
window._rb2p_throwPull: test-bot tuning knob (?bot= tabs): throw pull strength; not read by the game
window._rb2p_turnSeq: sequence number stamped on each rooms/{code}/turn write; readers use owner/at/why and ignore it
window._rb2p_userScoreAtDriveStart: user score at drive start; written at staging and at the cascade clear, never read by the page
window._rb2p_viewW: test-bot view-width override (?bot= tabs) for its aim maths; not read by the game
window._rb2p_visitId: visit identifier (day/id) for the visit beacon and the audit bind record; only logged

var:ballGateHoldN: counter of ball-gate holds, exposed via _rb2p_ballGateStats; telemetry only
var:beforeSuppressed: local of the console-only engine-PAT suppression self-test (suppress count before the reads); never in game flow

var:outSince: can-act monitor's 'resume never re-entered the match' timer; audit output only
var:statsSince: can-act monitor's 'stats screen missing' timer; audit output only
var:stuck: local counter in the console-only _rb2p_reproQuarterBurst repro (ticks parked at Vy=4); never in game flow
var:wakeLPending: screen wake-lock request in flight; only stops a duplicate navigator.wakeLock.request, nothing in play checks it
var:wedgeSince: can-act monitor's pointer-wedge timer; audit output only
storage:__rb_cb: once-per-tab cache-bust marker that reloads with a fresh ?v= before the game loads; never read during a match

storage:rb2p_ar_ts: time of the last AUTO-RECOVER/STUCK attempt; the reload was removed in V279, it only rate-limits a diag line
storage:rb2p_bookmarkHint: FINAL-screen bookmark tip shown once; display only
storage:rb2p_db_speed_mult: MAX-difficulty defensive-back speed multiplier setting; defender speed only
storage:rb2p_def_speed_bump: MAX-difficulty DL/LB speed increment setting; defender speed only
storage:rb2p_diff_mode: remembered SAME/DIFFERENT difficulty mode for the lobby; difficulty only
storage:rb2p_difficulty: the player's defense difficulty tier; sets engine aggression and op_difficulty, never a gate
storage:rb2p_enable_autotest: opt-in switch for the observe-only pick-six diagnostic auto-test; diagnostic only
storage:rb2p_name: player display name shown in the room; lobby only
storage:rb2p_news_v387: dismissed flag for the V387 news banner; display only
storage:rb2p_quarter_mins: last-picked quarter length remembered for the next room; it only seeds the lobby default, the match reads the room's agreed value (window._rb2p_quarterMins)
storage:rb2p_spawn_reload: time of the last poisoned-spawn/STUCK reload attempt; the reload was removed in V279, now only a boot-log label and a diag rate limit
storage:rb2p_ultramax_value: the ULTRAMAX custom defense-aggression value; defender difficulty only
storage:rb2p_vr_n: count of VIS-RECOVER reload attempts; the reload was removed in V279, it gates only a diag line
storage:rb2p_vr_ts: time of the last VIS-RECOVER attempt; the reload was removed in V279, it only rate-limits a diag line
room:audit: append-only telemetry stream (PATCHed every 1.5s and by the stall worker); the page never reads it
room:audited: external auditor's marker, only removed by the host at match start; the page never reads it
room:box: fire-and-forget offensive box-score write-through, read back only to restore stats on resume; stats content only
room:defstats: opponent-measured defensive stats merged into the FINAL card; content for the stats screen only
room:evt: event-popup records (TD/FG/INT/PICK6) the other phone blasts on its WAIT screen; display only
room:feed: play-by-play feed records shown on the WAIT screen; nothing in the game logic reads them
room:games: per-game start markers; the page reads the list only to pick which of its own flow records to restore after a reload, and a missing or newer marker can only discard a record (the flow rule then abstains), never add a refusal
room:names: player display names; read only in the lobby to find the host's seat
room:teams: team picks per role, mirrored into the team-id globals for jerseys and rosters; never a condition that waits
room:ver: build numbers per role for the version-mismatch banner and the popup capability check; display only
window._rb2p_flowRefusalLogMs: rate limit for the force-drive guard's log line (once per 5s); it only decides whether to write a diag
var:bothStuck: the can-act monitor's per-tick reading 'both phones parked, no decision' — telemetry for the checker; nothing waits on it
var:bothStuckLong: the same reading past its 5s grace — it only sets the monitor's must/can report (telemetry)
var:bothStuckSince: when the monitor first saw both phones parked with no decision — the start of its 5s grace, telemetry only

storage:rb2p_auditOutbox_: the audit outbox (V419): telemetry entries waiting to upload; nothing in the game waits on them
storage:rb2p_driveDir: V449: the player's chosen drive direction for their own screen (+1 right / -1 left); read at match launch only, never a gate
window._rb2p_convChoice: the last 1 PT / 2 PT choice {pts, at}, stamped where the engine dispatches the button (V424); the overtime try's set-up net acts only on a choice newer than the touchdown — it enables a set-up, it never holds one up
window._rb2p_engErrSeen: V430 telemetry: the engine errors already written to the audit stream (one 'engerr' entry per distinct error); only decides whether to log, never read by game logic
window._rb2p_lastFrameThrewMs: V430 telemetry: when a frame last threw; read only to word the can-act monitor's label ('the match never started (engine error)'), never gates play
window._rb2p_pollFailLogMs: V430 log throttle: the outcome poll's failure line at most every 15 s; never gates the poll
window._rb2p_resumedMs: V430: set when resumeMatch runs; read only to word the monitor's label (a resume vs this page's own match start), never gates play
window._rb2p_hornQ: the quarter whose horn this phone last ended through the engine's time-up (5: a drive refused after regulation; with _rb2p_hornMs it only throttles that log line); nothing waits on it
window._rb2p_hornMs: when this phone last ended a quarter through the engine's time-up (diagnostic); nothing waits on it
window._rb2p_convWallChoiceFor: V438: remembers which conversion offer the 'wall waits — the player chose and is lining up the try' diag line was already written for; gates only that log line
window._rb2p_fixedDir: V449: this player's held drive direction (+1/-1), seeded at every launch from rb2p_driveDir; _Sc1 is skipped and a stray _501 is put back to it — it corrects which way the field faces, never refuses or waits
window._rb2p_lastPressMs: V438: the time of this page's last in-match press (canvas pointerdown); the 35 s conversion wall reads it to wait 20 s from a player lining up its try, always within 90 s of the offer — a time, never a flag anything waits on
window._rb2p_view: V450: the opponent's-screen module (capture, codec, replay renderer, playback) — an API object; it holds no game state and nothing waits on it
window._rb2p_viewNoLink: V451 test seam: the opponent's-screen link is never installed on this page (bisecting a slowdown); the game never sets it
window._rb2p_viewNoP2P: V450 test seam: forces the opponent's-screen link onto its Firebase path; the game never sets it
storage:rb2p_readyGuardNote: V452 telemetry: the READY guard's read (the partner's heartbeat age/vis, its final's age) carried across the guard's reload so the resumed page can audit it at bind; read once and removed; nothing waits on it
